title: Burmese Egg Fried Rice
burmeseTitle: ထမင်းကြော်
summary: Simple fried rice with egg, shallots and a touch of turmeric.
steps: Heat oil in a pan and fry sliced shallots and garlic until light golden.
Add turmeric, then crack in the eggs and scramble them quickly.
Add the cooked rice and mix well, breaking up any lumps.
Season with fish sauce, then fold in chopped spring onion.
Serve hot with cucumber slices or a squeeze of lime if you have them.

title: Tomato and Egg Stir-fry
burmeseTitle: ခရမ်းချဉ်သီးကြက်ဥကြော်
summary: Soft tomatoes and scrambled egg cooked together in one pan.
steps: Cut the tomatoes into thin wedges and slice the shallots and garlic.
Fry shallots and garlic in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until they release their juice.
Push the tomatoes to one side, pour in the beaten eggs and scramble.
Mix everything together, season with fish sauce and top with spring onion.

title: Burmese Chicken Curry
burmeseTitle: ကြက်သားဟင်း
summary: A home-style oil-returns curry with onion, ginger and turmeric.
steps: Pound or blend onion, garlic and ginger with a little water into a paste.
Heat oil and fry the paste with turmeric until the raw smell is gone.
Add the chicken and fry until it turns opaque.
Add fish sauce and chili powder, then a cup of water.
Cover and simmer until the chicken is tender and the oil rises.
Taste, adjust the salt, and rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Ginger Pork Curry
burmeseTitle: ဝက်သားဂျင်းဟင်း
summary: Slow-cooked pork with young ginger and dark soy sauce.
steps: Slice the pork belly and young ginger into thin pieces.
Fry onion and garlic in oil until fragrant.
Add the pork and cook until lightly browned.
Add ginger, dark soy sauce and fish sauce.
Add water, cover, and simmer until the pork is soft.
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat.

title: Burmese Egg Curry
burmeseTitle: ကြက်ဥဟင်း
summary: Boiled eggs simmered in a light tomato and onion sauce.
steps: Boil the eggs, cool them in water, then peel and set aside.
Fry onion, garlic and turmeric in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until they break down.
Add chili powder, fish sauce and a little water to make a sauce.
Add the boiled eggs, spoon the sauce over them, and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Tomato Fish Curry
burmeseTitle: ငါးခရမ်းချဉ်သီးဟင်း
summary: Fish pieces cooked gently in a tomato sauce with green chili.
steps: Clean the fish and cut it into large pieces.
Fry onion, garlic, ginger and turmeric in oil until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook into a soft sauce.
Add fish sauce, green chili and a little water, then bring to a simmer.
Slide in the fish pieces, cover, and cook gently for 10 minutes.

title: Burmese Prawn Curry
burmeseTitle: ပုဇွန်ဟင်း
summary: Quick prawn curry with tomato and garlic.
steps: Peel and clean the prawns if needed.
Fry onion, garlic and turmeric in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until juicy.
Add the prawns and fish sauce, then stir until the prawns turn pink.
Simmer for a few minutes so the sauce clings to the prawns.

title: Burmese Split Pea Dhal
burmeseTitle: ပဲဟင်း
summary: Creamy split peas topped with golden fried onion and garlic.
steps: Rinse the split peas and boil them with turmeric until soft.
Mash some of the peas to make the dhal creamy.
Fry sliced onion, garlic and ginger in oil until golden.
Pour the fried mix into the dhal and stir well.
Season with fish sauce and simmer for 5 more minutes.

title: Potato and Chicken Curry
burmeseTitle: အာလူးကြက်သားဟင်း
summary: Family curry with soft potatoes in a light tomato gravy.
steps: Cut the chicken and potatoes into even chunks.
Fry onion and turmeric in oil until soft.
Add the chicken and cook until it changes colour.
Add tomatoes, chili powder and fish sauce, then stir well.
Add the potatoes and water, cover, and simmer until both are tender.

title: Burmese Fish Sour Soup
burmeseTitle: ငါးချဉ်ရည်ဟင်း
summary: Light tamarind broth with fish, tomato and green chili.
steps: Simmer tomatoes, onion and garlic in water until soft.
Add tamarind paste and fish sauce to make a light sour broth.
Add green chili and let the soup bubble gently.
Slide in the fish pieces and poach them until just cooked.
Taste the broth, adjust the sourness, and finish with coriander.

title: Gourd and Prawn Soup
burmeseTitle: ဘူးသီးပုဇွန်ဟင်းရည်
summary: Soft bottle gourd in a light prawn broth.
steps: Peel the gourd and cut it into small pieces.
Fry garlic and dried prawns in a little oil until fragrant.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Add the gourd and simmer until soft.
Season with fish sauce and black pepper before serving.

title: Coconut Chicken Noodles (Ohn No Khao Swe)
summary: Creamy coconut noodle soup topped with boiled egg.
steps: Fry onion, garlic, ginger and turmeric in oil until soft.
Add the chicken and cook until it changes colour.
Add coconut milk and simmer until the chicken is tender.
Mix chickpea flour with water and stir it in to thicken the sauce.
Season with fish sauce and serve over noodles with boiled egg slices.

title: Shan Style Noodles
summary: Rice noodles with a savoury chicken and tomato topping.
steps: Marinate the chicken with soy sauce and a little garlic.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Add tomatoes and cook until they soften into a rough sauce.
Cook the rice noodles and place them in bowls.
Top with the chicken mix, pickled greens, chili oil and crushed peanuts.

title: Mohinga (Fish Noodle Soup)
burmeseTitle: မုန့်ဟင်းခါး
summary: The classic breakfast noodle soup with catfish and banana stem.
steps: Simmer the fish with lemongrass until cooked, then remove the bones and flake it.
Fry onion, garlic, ginger and turmeric until fragrant.
Add the fish, fish sauce and the cooking broth.
Mix chickpea flour with water and stir it in to thicken the soup.
Add sliced banana stem and simmer until tender.
Serve the broth over rice noodles with coriander and lime.

title: Burmese Tea Leaf Salad
burmeseTitle: လက်ဖက်သုပ်
summary: Tangy fermented tea leaves tossed with crunchy toppings.
steps: Shred the cabbage and slice the tomato into thin wedges.
Mix fermented tea leaves with lime juice and a little fish sauce.
Combine the cabbage, tomato, peanuts, sesame and dried shrimp in a bowl.
Add the tea leaf mix and toss everything together.
Top with fried garlic and sliced green chili.

title: Burmese Ginger Salad
burmeseTitle: ဂျင်းသုပ်
summary: Thin young ginger strips with nuts, lime and a gentle heat.
steps: Slice the young ginger into very thin strips.
Soak the ginger in lime juice for a few minutes to soften the heat.
Slice the tomato and mix it with the ginger.
Add peanuts, sesame, dried shrimp and fish sauce, then toss.
Finish with fried garlic and sliced green chili.

title: Burmese Tomato Salad
burmeseTitle: ခရမ်းချဉ်သီးသုပ်
summary: A ten-minute salad that goes with any curry.
steps: Slice the tomatoes and shallots thinly.
Mix lime juice with fish sauce for the dressing.
Toss the tomatoes and shallots with the dressing.
Top with peanuts, coriander and sliced green chili.

title: Burmese Noodle Salad
burmeseTitle: ခေါက်ဆွဲသုပ်
summary: Cold noodles tossed with crunchy vegetables and lime dressing.
steps: Boil the noodles until just soft, then rinse in cold water.
Shred the cabbage and carrot into thin strips.
Mix lime juice, fish sauce and chili oil into a dressing.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables and dressing.
Top with sliced onion and crushed peanuts.

title: Stir-fried Morning Glory
burmeseTitle: ကန်စွန်းရွက်ကြော်
summary: A ten-minute greens dish with garlic and fish sauce.
steps: Wash the morning glory and cut it into short lengths.
Heat a little oil in a wok until very hot.
Fry the garlic for a few seconds until fragrant.
Add the morning glory and toss quickly over high heat.
Season with fish sauce and green chili, then serve at once.

title: Shan Tofu Salad
summary: Chickpea tofu cubes tossed with tomato, lime and chili oil.
steps: Cut the chickpea tofu into small cubes.
Slice the tomato and shred the cabbage.
Mix lime juice, fish sauce and chili oil into a dressing.
Toss the tofu, tomato and cabbage with the dressing.
Top with peanuts and coriander before serving.
